statement.zh: 将阿马尔那表述为「无前身的纯规划唯一首都」会过度简化；其规划特征与新王国迁都政治需分栏讨论。
statement.en: Calling Amarna a uniquely planned capital without precursors oversimplifies; planning features and New Kingdom relocation politics should stay distinct columns.

disclaimer: Hypothesis / popular framing — not a closed fact. Planned layout ≠ historically unique without comparative argument.
